parts.question: What is the current renal starting dose of AX-17?

result.answer: For normal renal function (eGFR >=90), the starting dose is 50 mg OD [E2]. For mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89), the starting dose is 50 mg OD [E2]. For moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the starting dose is 25 mg OD [E2], also stated as 25 mg once daily [E1, E3]. For severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29), the starting dose is Specialist review [E2].
